title: I would do it again
text: A very complete workshop, they explain the different techniques so that when it comes time to make the pot, in our case, you can choose the technique you felt most comfortable with during the practice. In addition, we were lucky to do the workshop only with Wendy because that day only my partner and I attended. And I highly recommend it, she was very attentive to us and in the end we had a more enriching experience.

author: Z4966RAjamesg

title: The ceramic course is perfect for beginners.
text:
The ceramic course is perfect for beginners. First, you’re shown the basics, and then you get to make your own flower pot with support from Eric and Wendy. They were both incredibly sweet, encouraging, and very helpful throughout the session. I’d never done a course like this before, so I was positively surprised by how much I enjoyed it.

If I could change one thing, I’d make the course about half an hour longer, because some of us were struggling to finish our pots in time. But overall: 10/10, would absolutely recommend!
author: denniskM4116HT

title: The most wholesome pottery class you’ll take
text:
We had such a lovely time at this pottery class. Eric and Wendy are a wonderful couple — so warm, friendly, and patient. They made our first pottery experience feel easy and fun while teaching us the basics. They even took gorgeous photos of us for us to cherish🥰

My partner and I made planters and enjoyed it thoroughly. Highly recommend this class for anyone, regardless of age — and they also offer private sessions! Looking forward to another class soon 💕

title: Great! To be repeated
text:
Hello! 
I really liked Wendy and Eric's workshop. You can make your pot and paint it in the same workshop. 
Besides, it is handmade, which is easier than with the machine.
